flip_blocked_by: Compilability is a two-member union with one free-text reason, so no declared axis separates 'the compiled survival ledger cannot stage this transition' from 'the compiled score kernel cannot represent this damage modifier' (D-101) or from 'this support template is not instantaneous'.  compilability_for folds all three, and the hand set answers only the first.

Immortal Path and Eclipse are in the hand set for a survival state no BehaviorRule declares at all — a below-half received-healing multiplier and a stack self-shield — so no fold over declarations can reproduce them.

Catalyst of Aeons and the three Doran's items compile to rules that are all Compilable; their hand-set reasons are the conservatism notes D-43 names, and turning them into declarations is a migration, not a flip.
counter_3 is not yet 0: stat_derivation is unmigrated, so the declaration base this fold reads is knowingly incomplete.
